definitions.explanation: A prefix attached to nouns to indicate that something is of Western (European or American) style or origin, in contrast to {和|わ} (Japanese-style). Common in food, clothing, room, and music terms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The house has both a Japanese-style room and a Western-style room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋装|ようそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{和装|わそう}→和装：21261_wasou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At weddings, many people enjoy wearing both Western-style and Japanese-style outfits.

notes:
Used almost exclusively as a prefix, paired with the matching {和|わ} prefix for the Japanese counterpart. Originally meant "ocean" — by extension, "things from across the ocean."

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧: Western food
- ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧: Western-style room
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧: Western clothes
- ⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧: Western-style
- ⟦{洋楽|ようがく}→洋楽：18619_yougaku⟧: Western music
- ⟦{洋画|ようが}→洋画：14741_youga⟧: Western film / Western painting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和|わ}: Japanese (style) — opposite prefix; ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧, ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧, ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧ etc.
